Task 1 Activity Report  
Objective 
Document the steps performed to accomplish Task 1 and summarize the progress achieved 
during the literature review process. 
Step 1: Requesting an Action Plan from AI 
At the beginning of the task, an AI assistant was asked to provide an action plan for 
completing Task 1. The proposed workflow included identifying the papers, extracting 
metadata, organizing the information in a spreadsheet, classifying the literature, and 
preparing a final synthesis report. 
Step 2: Extraction of Metadata from Research Papers 
A total of 31 PDF articles were reviewed using an AI assistant. Due to context limitations, 
the PDFs were uploaded in batches, with a version that could process only three papers at a 
time. For each batch, the AI generated a table containing the title, authors, journal, 
publication date, and keywords. 
Step 3: Compilation of Results in Excel 
The generated tables were manually copied and pasted into Microsoft Excel in order to 
build a consolidated inventory of the reviewed literature. 
Step 4: Planning the Completion of Task 1 
After compiling the inventory, the AI was consulted again to determine how to complete the 
remaining activities of Task 1. 
• Verify that all 31 papers are included in the inventory. 
• Classify papers according to their main research domains. 
• Identify recurring themes and research trends. 
• Create summary tables by topic. 
• Write a literature synthesis. 
• Prepare the final deliverable and conclusions. 
Current Progress 
The metadata extraction and inventory stages have been completed. The collected 
information has been consolidated in Excel, and the next step is to finalize the classification 

and synthesis of the literature. This report was made by AI, explaining the steps in the 
prompt
